_comment: My own connections, part 1 - the HOLDING LIST (Guy, 23 Nov 2026). One step: collect from the
My Connections page. Nothing in it can act on a person - no visit, no invite, no message, no
webhook. It stays PAUSED; lh-own-connections.py switches it on for a few minutes each night,
reads the top of the list (newest first, each person with the date they connected) and stops
the runner. The repeat is a year so Linked Helper never re-reads on its own.
NOT part of the default build - lh-own-connections.py builds it on a machine that is switched on
name: My connections - holding list (collect only)
description: Wingguy: only collects from My Connections. No visit, no invite, no message, no webhook.
